name: Tsukuyomi Maya
source: Maya serves as the head of the Shogun's bodyguards, leading [url=/c140]Tomoe Yukino[/url], [url=/c142]Kamiyo Tatsumi[/url], and [url=/c141]Ebisu Minagi[/url] in their duties. She is [url=/c129]Tsukuyomi Mana[/url]'s cousin.
